'''Organi Studios''' refers to the following:
* USA - Organi Studios of Tulsa, OK. A comprehensive design firm and animation house that creates a modern renaissance of design on the basis of innovation and derives inspiration from nature and our surroundings to generate fluid motion and organic design. Animation and GUI design are the largest divisions of Organi Studios. http://www.organistudios.com
* a community in the Rhodope Prefecture, Greece. [[Organi]] * an artist's workroom, or an artist and his or her employees who work within that studio. [[studio]]
{{Disambig}}

This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation]]. In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: page-title=, followed by the page's title. Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: {{disambig|page-title=***}}. === Additional templates === * {{t1|disambig-cleanup}} More specific, alternative templates exist, including: * {{tl|airport This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation]]. In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{t1|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Ambiguous place names]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Disambiguation lists of mountains]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|SIA}} for [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]] ===Parameters=== ''(will begin functioning shortly)'' If a general dab page includes (but is not limited to) more than one item in any of the above classes, then {{tl|disambig}} should still be used, but parameters can be added in order to place the page ''additionally'' into the above categories. Parameters are as follows (they may also be combined, in any order): *{{tlx|disambig|hn}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] *{{tlx|disambig|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] *{{tlx|disambig|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|mountain}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation lists of mountains]] *{{tlx|disambig|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] *{{tlx|disambig|road}}: for disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] ==For those who can't remember the name== For those who can't remember how the name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. ==See also== * {{tl|dablink}} - basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:Otheruses templates (example This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Disambiguation lists of mountains]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|SIA}} for [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]] === Parameters === If a general dab page includes more than one item in any of the above classes, then {{tl|disambig}} should still be used, but parameters can be added in order to place the page ''additionally'' into the above categories. Parameters are as follows (they may also be combined, in any order): *{{tlx|disambig|hn}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] *{{tlx|disambig|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] *{{tlx|disambig|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|mountain}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation lists of mountains]] *{{tlx|disambig|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] *{{tlx|disambig|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] *{{tlx|disambig|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] *{{tlx|disambig|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] === Alternative names === For those who can't remember how this template's name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. === Technical details === Internally this template uses {{tl|dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. === See also === * {{tl|dablink}} – Basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:Otheruses templates (example usage)]] for the full hatnote index. * {{tl|dn}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article. Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|SIA}} for [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]] === Parameters === If a general dab page includes more than one item in any of the above classes, then {{tl|disambig}} should still be used, but parameters can be added in order to place the page ''additionally'' into the above categories. Parameters are as follows (they may also be combined, in any order): *{{tlx|disambig|hn}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] *{{tlx|disambig|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] *{{tlx|disambig|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] *{{tlx|disambig|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] *{{tlx|disambig|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] *{{tlx|disambig|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] *{{tlx|disambig|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] === Alternative names === For those who can't remember how this template's name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. === Technical details === Internally this template uses {{tl|dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. === See also === * {{tl|dablink}} – Basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:Otheruses templates (example usage)]] for the full hatnote index. * {{tl|dn}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article. {{Documentation subpage}} {{high-use}} {{dabnav}} This is the {{tl|disambig}} template. '''Important: Please do not [[WP:SUBST|SUBST:]] this template.''' This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|SIA}} for [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]] === Parameters === If a general dab page includes more than one item in any of the above classes, then {{tl|disambig}} should still be used, but parameters can be added in order to place the page ''additionally'' into the above categories. Parameters are as follows (they may also be combined, in any order): *{{tlx|disambig|hn}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] (note that you must instead add the category separately if it needs a different [[WP:SORT|sort key]]) *{{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] *{{tlx|disambig|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] *{{tlx|disambig|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] *{{tlx|disambig|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] *{{tlx|disambig|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] *{{tlx|disambig|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] *{{tlx|disambig|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] === Alternative names === For those who can't remember how this template's name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. === Technical details === Internally this template uses {{tl|dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. === See also === * {{tl|dablink}} – Basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:Otheruses templates (example usage)]] for the full hatnote index. * {{tl|dn}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article. * {{tl|Shortcut disambig}} - For "Wikipedia namespace" pages associated with the same shortcut. revision.text: {{Documentation subpage}} {{high-use}} {{dabnav}} This is the {{tl|disambig}} template. '''Important: Please do not [[WP:SUBST|SUBST:]] this template.''' This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|SIA}} for [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]] * {{tl|WP disambig}} for Wikipedia project and help pages associated with a given shortcut or title === Parameters === If a general dab page includes more than one item in any of the above classes, then {{tl|disambig}} should still be used, but parameters can be added in order to place the page ''additionally'' into the above categories. Parameters are as follows (they may also be combined, in any order): *{{tlx|disambig|hn}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] (note that you must instead add the category separately if it needs a different [[WP:SORT|sort key]]) *{{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] *{{tlx|disambig|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] *{{tlx|disambig|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] *{{tlx|disambig|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] *{{tlx|disambig|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] *{{tlx|disambig|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] *{{tlx|disambig|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] === Alternative names === For those who can't remember how this template's name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. === Technical details === Internally this template uses {{tl|dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. === See also === * {{tl|dablink}} – Basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:Otheruses templates (example usage)]] for the full hatnote index. * {{tl|dn}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article. revision.text: {{documentation subpage}} {{high-risk| 100,000+ }} {{dabnav}} This is the {{tl|disambig}} template. '''Important: Please do not [[WP:SUBST|SUBST:]] this template.''' This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|SIA}} for [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]] ** {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] ** {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Set indices on mountains]] * {{tl|WP disambig}} for Wikipedia project and help pages associated with a given shortcut or title === Parameters === Sometimes there isn't a specific disambig template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|disambig}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. Up to ten parameters can be fed, and in any order. Like this: :{{tlc|disambig|school|hospital}} Only add a parameter if the disambig page has several items of that type. *{{tlx|disambig|hn}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] (note that you must instead add the category separately if it needs a different [[WP:SORT|sort key]]) *{{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] *{{tlx|disambig|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] *{{tlx|disambig|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] *{{tlx|disambig|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] *{{tlx|disambig|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] *{{tlx|disambig|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] *{{tlx|disambig|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] Note that {{tl|disambig}} might not have parameters for all subcategories of [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]], then you have to manually add the category to the disambig page. === Alternative names === For those who can't remember how this template's name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. === Technical details === Internally this template uses {{tl|dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. This template uses {{tl|disambig/cat}} to handle the categorisation parameters such as "hospital" and "school". === See also === * {{tl|dablink}} – Basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:Otheruses templates (example usage)]] for the full hatnote index. * {{tl|dn}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|SIA}} for [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]] ** {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] ** {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Set indices on mountains]] * {{tl|WP disambig}} for Wikipedia project and help pages associated with a given shortcut or title === Parameters === Sometimes there isn't a specific disambig template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|disambig}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. Up to ten parameters can be fed, and in any order. revision.text: {{documentation subpage}} {{high-risk| 100,000+ }} {{dabnav}} This is the {{tl|disambig}} template. '''Important: Please do not [[WP:SUBST|SUBST:]] this template.''' This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Callsigndis}} – [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Disambig-Chinese-char-title}} – [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tl|Fish-dab}} – [[:Category:Fish common names]] and [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|LatinNameDisambig}} – [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Letter disambig}} – Adds no special category but adds a Latin letter navbox. * {{tl|Letter-NumberCombDisambig}} – [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|MolFormDisambig}} – [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|SIA}} for [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]] ** {{tl|Hawaiiindex}} for Hawaii topics – [[:Category:Disambiguation lists of Hawaii-related topics]] ** {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Set indices on mountains]] ** {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] ** {{tl|Sportindex}} for sport names – [[:Category:Set indices on sports]] * {{tl|WP disambig}} for Wikipedia project and help pages associated with a given shortcut or title === Parameters === Sometimes there isn't a specific disambig template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|disambig}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. Up to ten parameters can be fed, and in any order. Like this: :{{tlc|disambig|school|hospital}} Only add a parameter if the disambig page has several items of that type. * {{tlx|disambig|human name}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] (note that you must instead add the category separately if it needs a different [[WP:SORT|sort key]]) * {{tlx|disambig|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] * {{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] * {{tlx|disambig|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tlx|disambig|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|chinese}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tlx|disambig|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|fish}}: for [[:Category:Fish common names]] * {{tlx|disambig|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|latin}}: for [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|letter number}}: for [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tlx|disambig|molform}}: for [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tlx|disambig|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tlx|disambig|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] * {{tlx|disambig|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tlx|disambig|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tlx|disambig|split}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages in need of being split]] For pages that need clean-up use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}, it understands the same parameters. Note that {{tl|disambig}} might not have parameters for all subcategories of [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]], then you have to manually add the category to the disambig page. === Alternative names === For those who can't remember how this template's name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. === Technical details === Internally this template uses {{tl|dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. This template uses {{tl|disambig/cat}} to handle the categorisation parameters such as "hospital" and "school". === See also === * {{tl|dablink}} – Basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:Otheruses templates (example usage)]] for the full hatnote index. * {{tl|dn}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article. revision.text: {{documentation subpage}} {{high-risk| 100,000+ }} {{dabnav}} This is the {{tl|disambig}} template. '''Important: Please do not [[Wikipedia:Substitution|subst:]] this template.''' This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Callsigndis}} – [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Disambig-Chinese-char-title}} – [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Letter disambig}} – Adds no special category but adds a Latin letter navbox. * {{tl|Letter-NumberCombDisambig}} – [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|MolFormDisambig}} – [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|SpeciesLatinNameDisambig}} – [[:Category:Species Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|WP disambig}} for Wikipedia project and help pages associated with a given shortcut or title For [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]]: * {{tl|SIA}} for any set index article – [[:Category:Set indices]] * {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Set indices on mountains]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|Sportindex}} for sport names – [[:Category:Set indices on sports]] * {{tl|Surname}} for people's surnames – [[:Category:Surnames]] * {{tl|Given name}} for people's given names – [[:Category:Given names]] === Parameters === Sometimes there isn't a specific disambig template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|disambig}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. Up to ten parameters can be fed, and in any order. Like this: :{{tlc|disambig|school|hospital}} Only add a parameter if the disambig page has several items of that type. * {{tlx|disambig|human name}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] (note that you must instead add the category separately if it needs a different [[WP:SORT|sort key]]) * {{tlx|disambig|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] * {{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] * {{tlx|disambig|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tlx|disambig|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|chinese}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tlx|disambig|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|fish}}: for [[:Category:Fish common names]] * {{tlx|disambig|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|latin}}: for [[:Category:Species Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|letter number}}: for [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tlx|disambig|molform}}: for [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tlx|disambig|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tlx|disambig|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] * {{tlx|disambig|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tlx|disambig|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tlx|disambig|split}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages in need of being split]] For pages that need clean-up use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}, it understands the same parameters. Note that {{tl|disambig}} might not have parameters for all subcategories of [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]], then you have to manually add the category to the disambig page. === Alternative names === For those who can't remember how this template's name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. === Technical details === Internally this template uses {{tl|dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. This template uses {{tl|disambig/cat}} to handle the categorisation parameters such as "hospital" and "school". === See also === * {{tl|dablink}} – Basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:Otheruses templates (example usage)]] for the full hatnote index. * {{tl|dn}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article. This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Callsigndis}} – [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Disambig-Chinese-char-title}} – [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Letter disambig}} – Adds no special category but adds a Latin letter navbox. * {{tl|Letter-NumberCombDisambig}} – [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|MolFormDisambig}} – [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|Species Latin name disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|WP disambig}} for Wikipedia project and help pages associated with a given shortcut or title For [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]]: * {{tl|SIA}} for any set index article – [[:Category:Set indices]] * {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Set indices on mountains]] * {{tl|Roadindex}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|Sportindex}} for sport names – [[:Category:Set indices on sports]] * {{tl|Surname}} for people's surnames – [[:Category:Surnames]] * {{tl|Given name}} for people's given names – [[:Category:Given names]] === Parameters === Sometimes there isn't a specific disambig template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|disambig}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. Up to ten parameters can be fed, and in any order. Like this: :{{tlc|disambig|school|hospital}} Only add a parameter if the disambig page has several items of that type. * {{tlx|disambig|human name}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] (note that you must instead add the category separately if it needs a different [[WP:SORT|sort key]]) * {{tlx|disambig|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] * {{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] * {{tlx|disambig|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tlx|disambig|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|chinese}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tlx|disambig|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|fish}}: for [[:Category:Fish common names]] * {{tlx|disambig|genus}}: for [[:Category:Genus disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|latin}}: for [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|letter number}}: for [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tlx|disambig|molform}}: for [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tlx|disambig|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tlx|disambig|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] * {{tlx|disambig|political}}: for [[:Category:Political party disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tlx|disambig|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tlx|disambig|split}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages in need of being split]] For pages that need clean-up use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}, it understands the same parameters. Note that {{tl|disambig}} might not have parameters for all subcategories of [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]], then you have to manually add the category to the disambig page. === Alternative names === For those who can't remember how this template's name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. === Technical details === Internally this template uses {{tl|dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. This template uses {{tl|disambig/cat}} to handle the categorisation parameters such as "hospital" and "school". === See also === * {{tl|dablink}} – Basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:Otheruses templates (example usage)]] for the full hatnote index. * {{tl|dn}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article. {{Documentation subpage}} {{High-risk| 130,000+ }} {{Dabnav}} This is the {{tl|Disambiguation}} template. '''Important: Please do not [[Wikipedia:Substitution|subst:]] this template.''' This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{Disambiguation|page-title = ***}}''' . ===Variant templates=== ====Disambiguation==== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. More specific and alternative templates do exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type: * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Callsigndis}} – [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Disambig-Chinese-char-title}} – [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospital disambiguation}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Letter disambig}} – adds a Latin letter navbox, does not auto-categorize * {{tl|Letter-NumberCombDisambig}} – [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|MolFormDisambig}} – [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|Species Latin name disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Wikipedia disambiguation}} for ambiguous titles and shortcuts in the Wikipedia namespace – [[:Category:Wikipedia project disambiguation pages]] ====Set index==== {{Category see also|Set index article templates}} For [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]]: * {{tl|SIA}} for any set index article – [[:Category:Set indices]] * {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Set indices on mountains]] * {{tl|Roadindex}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|Sportindex}} for sport names – [[:Category:Set indices on sports]] * {{tl|Surname}} for people's surnames – [[:Category:Surnames]] * {{tl|Given name}} for people's given names – [[:Category:Given names]] === Parameters === Sometimes there isn't a specific disambiguation template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|Disambiguation}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. Up to ten parameters can be fed, and in any order, for example: :{{tlc|disambiguation|school|hospital}} Only add a parameter if the disambiguation page has several items of that type. * {{tlx|Disambiguation|human name}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] (note that you must instead add the category separately if it needs a different [[WP:SORT|sort key]]) * {{tlx|Disambiguation|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|chinese}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|fish}}: for [[:Category:Fish common names]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|genus}}: for [[:Category:Genus disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|latin}}: for [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|letter number}}: for [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|molform}}: for [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|political}}: for [[:Category:Political party disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|split}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages in need of being split]] Note that {{tl|Disambiguation}} might not have parameters for all subcategories of [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]], then you have to manually add the category to the disambig page. === Redirects === The following redirect to this template: * {{tl|Disambig}} * {{tl|Dab}} * {{tl|DAB}} * {{tl|Disamb}} === Technical details === Internally, this template uses {{tl|Dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. This template also uses {{tl|Disambiguation/cat}} to handle the categorisation parameters, such as "hospital" and "school". === See also === * {{tl|Dablink}} – Basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:HATTEST]] for the full hatnote index. * {{tl|Dn}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article, see [[Wikipedia:OTHERUSES]] for more. This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{Disambiguation|page-title = ***}}''' . ===Variant templates=== ====Disambiguation==== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. More specific and alternative templates do exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type: * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Callsigndis}} – [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Disambig-Chinese-char-title}} – [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|MolFormDisambig}} – [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|Species Latin name disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Wikipedia disambiguation}} for ambiguous titles and shortcuts in the Wikipedia namespace – [[:Category:Wikipedia project disambiguation pages]] ====Set index==== {{Category see also|Set index article templates}} For [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]]: * {{tl|SIA}} for any set index article – [[:Category:Set indices]] * {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Set indices on mountains]] * {{tl|Roadindex}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set names – [[:Category:Given names]] === Parameters === Sometimes there isn't a specific disambiguation template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|Disambiguation}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. ±{{Documentation subpage}} {{High-risk| 130,000+ }} {{Dabnav}} This is the {{tl|Disambiguation}} template. '''Important: Please do not [[Wikipedia:Substitution|subst:]] this template.''' This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{Disambiguation|page-title = ***}}''' . ===Variant templates=== ====Disambiguation==== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. More specific and alternative templates do exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type: * {{tl|Airport disambiguation}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Call sign disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Chinese title disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospital disambiguation}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Letter disambiguation}} – adds a Latin letter navbox, does not auto-categorize * {{tl|Letter-NumberCombDisambig}} – [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Mathematical disambiguation}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Molecular formula disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|School disambiguation}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|Species Latin name disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Wikipedia disambiguation}} for ambiguous titles and shortcuts in the Wikipedia namespace – [[:Category:Wikipedia project disambiguation pages]] ====Set index==== {{Category see also|Set index article templates}} For [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]]: * {{tl|Set index article}} for any set index article – [[:Category:Set indices]] * {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Set indices on mountains]] * {{tl|Roadindex}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|Sportindex}} for sport names – [[:Category:Set indices on sports]] * {{tl|Surname}} for people's surnames – [[:Category:Surnames]] * {{tl|Given name}} for people's given names – [[:Category:Given names]] === Parameters === Sometimes there isn't a specific disambiguation template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|Disambiguation}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. Up to ten parameters can be fed, and in any order, for example: :{{tlc|Disambiguation|school|hospital}} Only add a parameter if the disambiguation page has several items of that type. * {{tlx|Disambiguation|human name}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] (note that you must instead add the category separately if it needs a different [[WP:SORTKEY|sort key]]) * {{tlx|Disambiguation|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|chinese}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|fish}}: for [[:Category:Fish common names]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|genus}}: for [[:Category:Genus disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|latin}}: for [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|letter number}}: for [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|molform}}: for [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|political}}: for [[:Category:Political party disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|split}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages in need of being split]] Note that {{tl|Disambiguation}} might not have parameters for all This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{Disambiguation|page-title = ***}}''' . ===Variant templates=== ====Disambiguation==== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. More specific and alternative templates do exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type: * {{tl|Airport disambiguation}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Call sign disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Chinese title disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human {{Documentation subpage}} {{High-risk|140,000+}} {{Dabnav}} This is the {{tl|Disambiguation}} template. '''Important: Please do not [[Wikipedia:Substitution|subst:]] this template.''' This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{Disambiguation|page-title = ***}}''' . ===Variant templates=== ====Disambiguation==== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. More specific and alternative templates do exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type: * {{tl|Airport disambiguation}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Call sign disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Chinese title disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospital disambiguation}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Letter disambiguation}} – adds a Latin letter navbox, does not auto-categorize * {{tl|Letter-NumberCombDisambig}} – [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Mathematical disambiguation}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Molecular formula disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|School disambiguation}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Species Latin name disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Wikipedia disambiguation}} for ambiguous titles and shortcuts in the Wikipedia namespace – [[:Category:Wikipedia project disambiguation pages]] ====Set index==== {{Category see also|Set index article templates}} For [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]]: * {{tl|Set index article}} for any set index article – [[:Category:Set indices]] * {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Set indices on mountains]] * {{tl|Roadindex}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|Sportindex}} for sport names – [[:Category:Set indices on sports]] * {{tl|Surname}} for people's surnames – [[:Category:Surnames]] * {{tl|Given name}} for people's given names – [[:Category:Given names]] === Parameters === Sometimes there isn't a specific disambiguation template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|Disambiguation}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. Up to ten parameters can be fed, and in any order, for example: :{{tlc|Disambiguation|school|hospital}} Only add a parameter if the disambiguation page has several items of that type. * {{tlx|Disambiguation|human name}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] (note that you must instead add the category separately if it needs a different [[WP:SORTKEY|sort key]]) * {{tlx|Disambiguation|given name}}: [[:Category:Given name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surname disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|chinese}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|fish}}: for [[:Category:Fish common names]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|genus}}: for [[:Category:Genus disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|latin}}: for [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|letter number}}: for [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|molform}}: for [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|political}}: for [[:Category:Political party disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|split}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages in need of being split]] Note that {{tl|Disambiguation}} might not have parameters for all subcategories of [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]], then you have to manually add the category to the disambig page. === Redirects === The following redirect to this template: * {{tl|Disambig}} * {{tl|Dab}} * {{tl|DAB}} * {{tl|Disamb}} === Technical details === Internally, this template uses {{tl|Dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. This template also uses {{tl|Disambiguation/cat}} to handle the categorisation parameters, such as "hospital" and "school". === See also === * [[Wikipedia:Hatnote]] * {{tl|Disambiguation needed}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article, see [[Wikipedia:OTHERUSES]] for more. * {{tl|WikiProject Disambiguation}} – for disambig talkpages revision.text: {{Documentation subpage}} {{High-risk|140,000+}} {{Dabnav}} This is the {{tl|Disambiguation}} template. '''Important: Please do not [[Wikipedia:Substitution|subst:]] this template.''' This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{Disambiguation|page-title = ***}}''' . ===Variant templates=== ====Disambiguation==== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. More specific and alternative templates do exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type: * {{tl|Airport disambiguation}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Call sign disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Chinese title disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospital disambiguation}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Letter disambiguation}} – adds a Latin letter navbox, does not auto-categorize * {{tl|Letter-NumberCombDisambig}} – [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Mathematical disambiguation}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Molecular formula disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|School disambiguation}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Species Latin name disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Wikipedia disambiguation}} for ambiguous titles and shortcuts in the Wikipedia namespace – [[:Category:Wikipedia project disambiguation pages]] ====Set index==== {{Category see also|Set index article templates}} For [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]]: * {{tl|Set index article}} for any set index article – [[:Category:Set indices]] * {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Set indices on mountains]] * {{tl|Roadindex}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|Sportindex}} for sport names – [[:Category:Set indices on sports]] * {{tl|Surname}} for people's surnames – [[:Category:Surnames]] * {{tl|Given name}} for people's given names – [[:Category:Given names]] === Parameters === Sometimes there isn't a specific disambiguation template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|Disambiguation}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. Up to ten parameters can be fed, and in any order, for example: :{{tlc|Disambiguation|school|hospital}} Only add a parameter if the disambiguation page has several items of that type. * {{tlx|Disambiguation|human name}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] (note that you must instead add the category separately if it needs a different [[WP:SORTKEY|sort key]]) * {{tlx|Disambiguation|given name}}: [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with given-name-holder lists]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|surname}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with surname-holder lists]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|chinese}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|fish}}: for [[:Category:Fish common names]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|genus}}: for [[:Category:Genus disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|latin}}: for [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|letter number}}: for [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|molform}}: for [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|political}}: for [[:Category:Political party disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|split}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages in need of being split]] Note that {{tl|Disambiguation}} might not have parameters for all subcategories of [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]], then you have to manually add the category to the disambig page. === Redirects === The following redirect to this template: * {{tl|Disambig}} * {{tl|Dab}} * {{tl|DAB}} * {{tl|Disamb}} === Technical details === Internally, this template uses {{tl|Dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. This template also uses {{tl|Disambiguation/cat}} to handle the categorisation parameters, such as "hospital" and "school". === See also === * [[Wikipedia:Hatnote]] * {{tl|Disambiguation needed}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article, see [[Wikipedia:OTHERUSES]] for more. * {{tl|WikiProject Disambiguation}} – for disambig talkpages
