This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]].
== Page title fixes == This template will automatically detect incomplete disambiguation present in page titles. If the title includes anything other than (disambiguation) in parentheses, it is assumed to be the article type. For example, this template on the page [[1st Division (France)]] would produce the text "This disambiguation page lists France articles associated with the title '''1st Division'''". If the page title contains parentheses that are not used for disambiguation (such as [[Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex* (*But Were Afraid to Ask)]]), set {{para|ignore_parentheses|yes}}. If you wish to manually specify the article type, use the {{para|type}} parameter.
==Variant templates== ===Disambiguation=== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}}
For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}.
More specific and alternative templates exist for disambiguation pages whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type: * {{tl|Airport disambiguation}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Biology disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Biology disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Call sign disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Caselaw disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Case law disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Chinese title disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tl|Genus disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Genus disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Human name disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Human name disambiguation cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospital disambiguation}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Letter-number combination disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Mathematical disambiguation}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematics disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Military unit disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Military units and formations disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Number disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Phonetics disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Linguistics disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Place name disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Road disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Road disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|School disambiguation}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Species Latin name disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Station disambiguation}} for railway and public transport stations – [[:Category:Station disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Synagogue disambiguation}} for synagogues – [[:Category:Synagogue disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Wikipedia disambiguation}} for ambiguous titles and shortcuts in the Wikipedia namespace – [[:Category:Wikipedia disambiguation pages]]
'''Note:''' A set index article (SIA) is ''not'' a disambiguation page; it is a list article about a set of items ''of a specific type'' that ''also'' share the same (or similar) name. [[Wikipedia:Set index articles]] includes templates for SIAs.
== Parameters == Sometimes there isn't a specific disambiguation template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|Disambiguation}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. Up to ten parameters can be fed, and in any order, for example:
:{{tlc|Disambiguation|school|hospital}}
Only add a parameter from this list if the disambiguation page has several items of that type: * {{tlx|Disambiguation|human name}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tlx|Disambiguation|hn{{=}}sortkey}} for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] with a specified [[WP:SORTKEY|sort key]] (e.g. {{tlx|Disambiguation|hn{{=}}Doe, John}}) * {{tlx|Disambiguation|political}}: for [[:Category:Political party disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|road}}: for [[:Category:Road disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|ship}}: for [[:Category:Ship disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|station}}: for [[:Category:Station disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|tndis}}: for [[:Category:Title and name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|township}}: for [[:Category:Township name disambiguation pages]]
These can be added if there are one or more elements in the list (per their category descriptions): * {{tlx|Disambiguation|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]]

* {{tlx|Disambiguation|given name}}: [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with given-name-holder lists]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|surname}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with surname-holder lists]]
This parameter reflects the title, not the contents:
* {{tlx|Disambiguation|chinese}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]]
And this parameter reflects a maintenance need, not the contents:
* {{tlx|Disambiguation|split}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages in need of being split]]
Note that {{tl|Disambiguation}} might not have parameters for all subcategories of [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]], then you have to manually add the category to the disambig page.
=== Nocat === If categorization is not needed on pages that are not in [[WP:MAINSPACE|mainspace]], then the "nocat" parameter may be set equal to "true" or "yes" as follows: * {{tlx|Disambiguation|nocat{{=}}true}} * {{tlx|Disambiguation|nocat{{=}}yes}}

* {{tl|Disambig}} * {{tl|Dab}} * {{tl|Disamb}}

This template also uses {{tl|Disambiguation/cat}} to handle the categorisation parameters, such as "hospital" and "school".

== Parameters == Sometimes there isn't a specific disambiguation template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|Disambiguation}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. Up to ten parameters can be fed, and in any order, for example:
:{{tlc|Disambiguation|school|hospital}}
Only add a parameter from this list if the disambiguation page has several items of that type: * {{tlx|Disambiguation|human name}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tlx|Disambiguation|hn{{=}}sortkey}} for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] with a specified [[WP:SORTKEY|sort key]] (e.g. {{tlx|Disambiguation|hn{{=}}Doe, John}}) * {{tlx|Disambiguation|bird}}: for [[:Category:Bird common name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|county}}: for [[:Category:County name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tlx|Disambiguation|uscounty}}: for [[:Category:United States county name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|fish}}: for [[:Category:Fish common name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|genus}}: for [[:Category:Genus disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|latin}}: for [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|letter number}}: for [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematics disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|political}}: for [[:Category:Political party disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|road}}: for [[:Category:Road disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|ship}}: for [[:Category:Ship disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|station}}: for [[:Category:Station disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|tndis}}: for [[:Category:Title and name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|township}}: for [[:Category:Township name disambiguation pages]]
These can be added if there are one or more elements in the list (per their category descriptions): * {{tlx|Disambiguation|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]]
These can be added even if there's only one element in the list, since these types are not actually ambiguous:
* {{tlx|Disambiguation|given name}}: [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with given-name-holder lists]] * {{tlx|Disambiguation|surname}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with surname-holder lists]]
This parameter reflects the title, not the contents:
* {{tlx|Disambiguation|chinese}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]]
And this parameter reflects a maintenance need, not the contents:
* {{tlx|Disambiguation|split}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages in need of being split]]
Note that {{tl|Disambiguation}} might not have parameters for all subcategories of [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]], then you have to manually add the category to the disambig page.
=== Nocat === If categorization is not needed on pages that are not in [[WP:MAINSPACE|mainspace]], then the "nocat" parameter may be set equal to "true" or "yes" as follows: * {{tlx|Disambiguation|nocat{{=}}true}} * {{tlx|Disambiguation|nocat{{=}}yes}}
== Redirects == The following redirect to this template:
* {{tl|Disambig}} * {{tl|Dab}} * {{tl|Disamb}}
== Technical details == Internally, this template uses {{tl|Dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]].
This template also uses {{tl|Disambiguation/cat}} to handle the categorisation parameters, such as "hospital" and "school".
Other templates and modules used: * {{tl|Disambiguation page short description}} * {{tl|Template other}} * {{tl|Title disambig text}} * {{tl|PAGENAMEBASE}} * {{tl|Trim}} * {{tl|Str rep}} * {{m2|Redirect|isRedirect}}
== Template use == Place template at the foot of the disambiguation page after all of the disambiguation content but before any categories (see below) (interlanguage links to Wikidata), as per the [[WP:DCAT]] guideline.

This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. == Page title fixes == This template will automatically detect incomplete disambiguation present in page titles. If the title includes anything other than (disambiguation) in parentheses, it is assumed to be the article type. For example, this template on the page [[1st Division (France)]] would produce the text "This disambiguation page lists France articles associated with the title '''1st Division'''". If the page title contains parentheses that are not used for disambiguation (such as [[Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex* (*But Were Afraid to Ask)]]), set {{para|ignore_parentheses|yes}}. If you wish to manually specify the article type, use the {{para|type}} parameter. ==Variant templates== ===Disambiguation=== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. {{pp-vandalism|small=yes}}{{Documentation subpage}} {{for|the inline tag|Template:Disambiguation needed}} {{High-use| 189183 }} {{Nosubst}} {{Dabnav}} {{tsh|Dab|Disambig}} This is the {{tl|Disambiguation}} template. This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. == Page title fixes == This template will automatically detect incomplete disambiguation present in page titles. If the title includes anything other than (disambiguation) in parentheses, it is assumed to be the article type. For example, this template on the page [[1st Division (France)]] would produce the text "This disambiguation page lists France articles associated with the title '''1st Division'''". If the page title contains parentheses that are not used for disambiguation (such as [[Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex* (*But Were Afraid to Ask)]]), set {{para|ignore_parentheses|yes}}. If you wish to manually specify the article type, use the {{para|type}} parameter. ==Variant templates== ===Disambiguation=== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. More specific and alternative templates exist for disambiguation pages whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type: * {{tl|Airport disambiguation}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Biology disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Biology disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Call sign disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Caselaw disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Case law disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Chinese title disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tl|Genus disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Genus disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Human name disambiguation}} – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Human name disambiguation cleanup}} * This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. == Page title fixes == This template will automatically detect incomplete disambiguation present in page titles. If the title includes anything other than (disambiguation) in parentheses, it is assumed to be the article type. For example, this template on the page [[1st Division (France)]] would produce the text "This disambiguation page lists France articles associated with the title '''1st Division'''". If the page title contains parentheses that are not used for disambiguation (such as [[Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex* (*But Were Afraid to Ask)]]), set {{para|ignore_parentheses|yes}}. If you wish to manually specify the article type, use the {{para|type}} parameter. ==Variant templates== ===Disambiguation=== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. == Page title fixes == This template will automatically detect incomplete disambiguation present in page titles. If the title includes anything other than (disambiguation) in parentheses, it is assumed to be the article type. For example, this template on the page [[1st Division (France)]] would produce the text "This disambiguation page lists France articles associated with the title '''1st Division'''". If the page title contains parentheses that are not used for disambiguation (such as [[Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex* (*But Were Afraid to Ask)]]), set {{para|ignore_parentheses|yes}}. If you wish to manually specify the article type, use the {{para|type}} parameter. ==Variant templates== ===Disambiguation=== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. More specific and alternative templates exist for disambiguation pages whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type: {| |- style="text-align:left" ! Template !! Category !! This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. == Page title fixes == This template will automatically detect incomplete disambiguation present in page titles. If the title includes anything other than (disambiguation) in parentheses, it is assumed to be the article type. For example, this template on the page [[1st Division (France)]] would produce the text "This disambiguation page lists France articles associated with the title '''1st Division'''". If the page title contains parentheses that are not used for disambiguation (such as [[Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex* (*But Were Afraid to Ask)]]), set {{para|ignore_parentheses|yes}}. If you wish to manually specify the article type, use the {{para|type}} parameter. ==Variant templates== ===Disambiguation=== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. :''This template documentation is [[Wikipedia:Template doc page pattern|transcluded]] from [[{{FULLPAGENAME}}/doc]]'' [[{{fullurl:{{FULLPAGENAMEE}}/doc|action=edit}} edit]] ---- '''Attention: Please do not [[WP:SUBST|Subst:]] this template.''' ==Usage== The [[Template:disambig|{{disambig}} template]] is placed at the bottom of articles which exist to help readers find other articles with similar names (or which perhaps should have the same name). This concept is called [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|Disambiguation]]. Disambiguation is used with common words such as [[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]], [[Life (disambiguation)|life]], and [[work]]. This is the most general-purpose disambiguation template; consider using a more-specific alternative if one exists, such as *[[:Template:Hndis]], for people's names *[[:Template:geodis]], for place names *[[:Template:TLAdisambig]], for [[three-letter acronym]]s === For those who can't remember the name === For those who can't remember where the name is abbreviated: [[Template:Disambiguation]], a "synonym". This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. == Page title fixes == This template will automatically detect incomplete disambiguation present in page titles. If the title includes anything other than (disambiguation) in parentheses, it is assumed to be the article type. For example, this template on the page [[1st Division (France)]] would produce the text "This disambiguation page lists France articles associated with the title '''1st Division'''". If the page title contains parentheses that are not used for disambiguation (such as [[Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex* (*But Were Afraid to Ask)]]), set {{para|ignore_parentheses|yes}}. If you wish to manually specify the article type, use the {{para|type}} parameter. ==Variant templates== ===Disambiguation=== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. {{pp-vandalism|small=yes}} {{Documentation subpage}} {{for|the inline tag|Template:Disambiguation needed}} {{High-use}} {{Nosubst}} {{Dabnav}} {{tsh|Dab|Disambig}} This is the {{tl|Disambiguation}} template. This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. == Page title fixes == This template will automatically detect incomplete disambiguation present in page titles. If the title includes anything other than (disambiguation) in parentheses, it is assumed to be the article type. For example, this template on the page [[1st Division (France)]] would produce the text "This disambiguation page lists France articles associated with the title '''1st Division'''". If the page title contains parentheses that are not used for disambiguation (such as [[Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex* (*But Were Afraid to Ask)]]), set {{para|ignore_parentheses|yes}}. If you wish to manually specify the article type, use the {{para|type}} parameter. ==Variant templates== ===Disambiguation=== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. More specific and alternative templates exist for disambiguation pages whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type: {| |- style="text-align:left" ! Template !! Category !! Notes |- | {{tl|Airport disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Airport disambiguation pages]] || for airports |- | {{tl|Biology disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Biology disambiguation pages]] |- | {{tl|Call sign disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] |- | {{tl|Caselaw disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Case law disambiguation pages]] |- | {{tl|Chinese title disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] |- | {{tl|Genus disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Genus disambiguation pages]] |- | {{tl|Human name disambiguation}}

[[Wikipedia:Set index articles]] includes templates for SIAs. == Parameters == Sometimes there isn't a specific disambiguation template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|Disambiguation}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. Up to ten parameters can be fed, and in any order. This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. == Page title fixes == This template will automatically detect incomplete disambiguation present in page titles. If the title includes anything other than (disambiguation) in parentheses, it is assumed to be the article type. For example, this template on the page [[1st Division (France)]] would produce the text "This disambiguation page lists France articles associated with the title '''1st Division'''". If the page title contains parentheses that are not used for disambiguation (such as [[Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex* (*But Were Afraid to Ask)]]), set {{para|ignore_parentheses|yes}}. If you wish to manually specify the article type, use the {{para|type}} parameter. ==Variant templates== ===Disambiguation=== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. {{pp-vandalism|small=yes}} {{Documentation subpage}} {{for|the inline tag|Template:Disambiguation needed}} {{High-use}} {{Nosubst}} {{Auto short description|indirect=yes}} {{Dabnav}} {{tsh|Dab|Disambig}} This is the {{tl|Disambiguation}} template. This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. == Page title fixes == This template will automatically detect incomplete disambiguation present in page titles. If the title includes anything other than (disambiguation) in parentheses, it is assumed to be the article type. For example, this template on the page [[1st Division (France)]] would produce the text "This disambiguation page lists France articles associated with the title '''1st Division'''". If the page title contains parentheses that are not used for disambiguation (such as [[Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex* (*But Were Afraid to Ask)]]), set {{para|ignore_parentheses|yes}}. If you wish to manually specify the article type, use the {{para|type}} parameter. ==Variant templates== ===Disambiguation=== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. revision.comment: Disambiguating links to [[1st Division]] (intentional link to DAB) using [[User:Qwertyytrewqqwerty/DisamAssist|DisamAssist]].
revision.text:
{{pp-vandalism|small=yes}} {{Documentation subpage}} {{for|the inline tag|Template:Disambiguation needed}} {{High-use}} {{Nosubst}} {{Auto short description|indirect=yes}} {{Dabnav}} {{tsh|Dab|Disambig}} This is the {{tl|Disambiguation}} template. This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. == Page title fixes == This template will automatically detect incomplete disambiguation present in page titles. If the title includes anything other than (disambiguation) in parentheses, it is assumed to be the article type. For example, this template on the page [[1st Division (disambiguation)|1st Division (France)]] would produce the text "This disambiguation page lists France articles associated with the title '''1st Division'''". If the page title contains parentheses that are not used for disambiguation (such as [[Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex* (*But Were Afraid to Ask)]]), set {{para|ignore_parentheses|yes}}. If you wish to manually specify the article type, use the {{para|type}} parameter. ==Variant templates== ===Disambiguation=== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. More specific and alternative templates exist for disambiguation pages whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type: {| |- style="text-align:left" ! Template !! Category !! Notes |- | {{tl|Airport disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Airport disambiguation pages]] || for airports |- | {{tl|Biology disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Biology disambiguation pages]] |- | {{tl|Call sign disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] |- | {{tl|Caselaw disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Case law disambiguation pages]] |- | {{tl|Chinese title disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] |- | {{tl|Genus disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Genus disambiguation pages]] |- | {{tl|Hangul title disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Hangul titles]] |- | {{tl|Human name disambiguation}}
{{pad}}{{tl|Human name disambiguation cleanup}} || [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] |- | {{tl|Hospital disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] || for hospitals or medical centers |- | {{tl|Letter–number combination disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Letter–number combination disambiguation pages]] |- | {{tl|Mathematical disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Mathematics disambiguation pages]] || for mathematics titles |- | {{tl|Military unit disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Military units and formations disambiguation pages]] |- | {{tl|Number disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] |- | {{tl|Phonetics disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Linguistics disambiguation pages]] |- | {{tl|Place name disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] |- | {{tl|Road disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Road disambiguation pages]] |- | {{tl|School disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation pages]] || for educational institutions |- | {{tl|Species Latin name disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Species Latin name disambiguation pages]] |- | {{tl|Station disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Station disambiguation pages]] || for railway and public transport stations |- | {{tl|Synagogue disambiguation}} || [[:Category:Synagogue disambiguation pages]] || for synagogues |} '''Note:''' A set index article (SIA) is ''not'' a disambiguation page; it is a list article about a set of items ''of a specific type'' that ''also'' share the same (or similar) name. [[Wikipedia:Set index articles]] includes templates for SIAs. == Parameters == Sometimes there isn't a specific disambiguation template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|Disambiguation}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. Up to ten parameters can be fed, and in any order. For example: :{{tlc|Disambiguation|school|hospital}} {| |colspan=2| Only add a parameter from this list if the disambiguation page has '''several''' items of that type: |- |style="vertical-align:top"| {{tlx|Disambiguation|human name}} (or name, names, human name, human names, or hndis)
{{pad}}{{tlx|Disambiguation|hn{{=}}''sortkey''}} || for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]]
{{pad}}for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] with a specified [[WP:SORTKEY|sort key]] (e.g. {{tlx|Disambiguation|hn{{=}}Doe, John}}) |- | {{tlx|Disambiguation|animal}} || for [[:Category:Animal common name disambiguation pages‎]] |- | {{tlx|Disambiguation|architecture}} || for [[:Category:Architectural disambiguation pages‎]] |- | {{tlx|Disambiguation|biology}} || for [[:Category:Biology disambiguation pages‎]] |- | {{tlx|Disambiguation|bird}} || for [[:Category:Bird common name disambiguation pages]] |- | {{tlx|Disambiguation|building and structure}} (or building, buildings,

{{pp-vandalism|small=yes}} {{Documentation subpage}} {{for|the inline tag|Template:Disambiguation needed}} {{High-use}} {{Nosubst}} {{Auto short description|indirect=yes}} {{Dabnav}} {{tsh|Dab|Disambig}} This is the {{tl|Disambiguation}} template. This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. == Page title fixes == This template will automatically detect incomplete disambiguation present in page titles. If the title includes anything other than (disambiguation) in parentheses, it is assumed to be the article type. For example, this template on the page [[1st Division (disambiguation)|1st Division (France)]] would produce the text "This disambiguation page lists France articles associated with the title '''1st Division'''". If the page title contains parentheses that are not used for disambiguation (such as [[Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex* (*But Were Afraid to Ask)]]), set {{para|ignore_parentheses|yes}}. If you wish to manually specify the article type, use the {{para|type}} parameter. ==Variant templates== ===Disambiguation=== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. == Page title fixes == This template will automatically detect incomplete disambiguation present in page titles. If the title includes anything other than (disambiguation) in parentheses, it is assumed to be the article type. For example, this template on the page [[1st Division (disambiguation)|1st Division (France)]] would produce the text "This disambiguation page lists France articles associated with the title '''1st Division'''". If the page title contains parentheses that are not used for disambiguation (such as [[Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex* (*But Were Afraid to Ask)]]), set {{para|ignore_parentheses|yes}}. If you wish to manually specify the article type, use the {{para|type}} parameter. ==Variant templates== ===Disambiguation=== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. == Page title fixes == This template will automatically detect incomplete disambiguation present in page titles. If the title includes anything other than (disambiguation) in parentheses, it is assumed to be the article type. For example, this template on the page [[1st Division (disambiguation)|1st Division (France)]] would produce the text "This disambiguation page lists France articles associated with the title '''1st Division'''". If the page title contains parentheses that are not used for disambiguation (such as [[Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex* (*But Were Afraid to Ask)]]), set {{para|ignore_parentheses|yes}}. If you wish to manually specify the article type, use the {{para|type}} parameter. ==Variant templates== ===Disambiguation=== {{Category see also|Disambiguation message boxes}} For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|Disambiguation cleanup}}. '''Organi Studios''' refers to the following:
* USA - Organi Studios of Tulsa, OK. A comprehensive design firm and animation house that creates a modern renaissance of design on the basis of innovation and derives inspiration from nature and our surroundings to generate fluid motion and organic design. Animation and GUI design are the largest divisions of Organi Studios. http://www.organistudios.com
* a community in the Rhodope Prefecture, Greece. [[Organi]] * an artist's workroom, or an artist and his or her employees who work within that studio. [[studio]]
{{Disambig}}

{{template doc page transcluded}}{{template doc page viewed directly}} '''Attention: Please do not [[WP:SUBST|SUBST:]] this template.''' == Usage == {{Dabnav}} {{tl|{{PAGENAME}}}} is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation]]. In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: page-title=, followed by the page's title. Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: {{disambig|page-title=***}}. === Additional templates === * {{t1|disambig-cleanup}} More specific, alternative templates exist, including: * {{tl|airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Ambiguous place names]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – revision.text: {{template doc page transcluded}}{{template doc page viewed directly}} ==Important== '''Attention: Please do not [[WP:SUBST|SUBST:]] this template.''' ==Usage== {{Dabnav}} {{tl|{{PAGENAME}}}} is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation]]. In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{ |page-title = }}''' , followed by the page's title. Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Additional templates === * {{t1|disambig-cleanup}} More specific, alternative templates exist, including: * {{tl|airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Ambiguous place names]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Disambiguation lists of mountains]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|POWdis}} for places of worship – [[:Category:Place of worship disambiguation]] (This template is currently redirected to {{tl|disambig}} and [[:Category:Disambiguation]]) * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|SIA}} for [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]] ==For those who can't remember the name== For those who can't remember how the name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. ==See also== * Parameters are as follows (they may also be combined, in any order): *{{tlx|disambig|hn}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation]]. In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{t1|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Ambiguous place names]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Disambiguation lists of mountains]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|SIA}} for [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]] ===Parameters=== ''(will begin functioning shortly)'' If a general dab page includes (but is not limited to) more than one item in any of the above classes, then {{tl|disambig}} should still be used, but parameters can be added in order to place the page ''additionally'' into the above categories. Parameters are as follows (they may also be combined, in any order): *{{tlx|disambig|hn}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Disambiguation lists of mountains]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|SIA}} for [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]] === Parameters === If a general dab page includes more than one item in any of the above classes, then {{tl|disambig}} should still be used, but parameters can be added in order to place the page ''additionally'' into the above categories. Parameters are as follows (they may also be combined, in any order): *{{tlx|disambig|hn}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] *{{tlx|disambig|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] *{{tlx|disambig|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|mountain}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation lists of mountains]] *{{tlx|disambig|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] *{{tlx|disambig|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] *{{tlx|disambig|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] *{{tlx|disambig|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] === Alternative names === For those who can't remember how this template's name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. === Technical details === Internally this template uses {{tl|dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. === See also === * {{tl|dablink}} – Basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:Otheruses templates (example usage)]] for the full hatnote index. * {{tl|dn}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article. Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|SIA}} for [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]] === Parameters === If a general dab page includes more than one item in any of the above classes, then {{tl|disambig}} should still be used, but parameters can be added in order to place the page ''additionally'' into the above categories. Parameters are as follows (they may also be combined, in any order): *{{tlx|disambig|hn}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] *{{tlx|disambig|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] *{{tlx|disambig|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] *{{tlx|disambig|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] *{{tlx|disambig|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] *{{tlx|disambig|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] *{{tlx|disambig|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] === Alternative names === For those who can't remember how this template's name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. === Technical details === Internally this template uses {{tl|dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. === See also === * {{tl|dablink}} – Basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:Otheruses templates (example usage)]] for the full hatnote index. * {{tl|dn}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article. {{Documentation subpage}} {{high-use}} {{dabnav}} This is the {{tl|disambig}} template. '''Important: Please do not [[WP:SUBST|SUBST:]] this template.''' This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|SIA}} for [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]] === Parameters === If a general dab page includes more than one item in any of the above classes, then {{tl|disambig}} should still be used, but parameters can be added in order to place the page ''additionally'' into the above categories. Parameters are as follows (they may also be combined, in any order): *{{tlx|disambig|hn}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] (note that you must instead add the category separately if it needs a different [[WP:SORT|sort key]]) *{{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] *{{tlx|disambig|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] *{{tlx|disambig|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] *{{tlx|disambig|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] *{{tlx|disambig|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] *{{tlx|disambig|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] *{{tlx|disambig|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] === Alternative names === For those who can't remember how this template's name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. === Technical details === Internally this template uses {{tl|dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. === See also === * {{tl|dablink}} – Basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:Otheruses templates (example usage)]] for the full hatnote index. * {{tl|dn}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article. * {{tl|Shortcut disambig}} - For "Wikipedia namespace" pages associated with the same shortcut. revision.text: {{documentation subpage}} {{high-risk| 100,000+ }} {{dabnav}} This is the {{tl|disambig}} template. '''Important: Please do not [[WP:SUBST|SUBST:]] this template.''' This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|SIA}} for [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]] ** {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] ** {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Set indices on mountains]] * {{tl|WP disambig}} for Wikipedia project and help pages associated with a given shortcut or title === Parameters === If a general dab page includes more than one item in any of the above classes, then {{tl|disambig}} should still be used, but parameters can be added in order to place the page ''additionally'' into the above categories. Parameters are as follows (they may also be combined, in any order): *{{tlx|disambig|hn}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] (note that you must instead add the category separately if it needs a different [[WP:SORT|sort key]]) *{{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] *{{tlx|disambig|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] *{{tlx|disambig|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous hospital names]] *{{tlx|disambig|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] *{{tlx|disambig|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] *{{tlx|disambig|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] *{{tlx|disambig|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] === Alternative names === For those who can't remember how this template's name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. === Technical details === Internally this template uses {{tl|dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. This template uses {{tl|disambig/cat}} to handle the categorisation parameters such as "hospital" and "school". === See also === * {{tl|dablink}} – Basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:Otheruses templates (example usage)]] for the full hatnote index. * {{tl|dn}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article. revision.text: {{documentation subpage}} {{high-risk| 100,000+ }} {{dabnav}} This is the {{tl|disambig}} template. '''Important: Please do not [[WP:SUBST|SUBST:]] this template.''' This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|SIA}} for [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]] ** {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] ** {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Set indices on mountains]] * {{tl|WP disambig}} for Wikipedia project and help pages associated with a given shortcut or title === Parameters === Sometimes there isn't a specific disambig template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|disambig}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. Up to ten parameters can be fed, and in any order. Like this: :{{tlc|disambig|school|hospital}} Only add a parameter if the disambig page has several items of that type. *{{tlx|disambig|hn}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] (note that you must instead add the category separately if it needs a different [[WP:SORT|sort key]]) *{{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] *{{tlx|disambig|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] *{{tlx|disambig|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] *{{tlx|disambig|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] *{{tlx|disambig|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] *{{tlx|disambig|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] *{{tlx|disambig|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] *{{tlx|disambig|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] Note that {{tl|disambig}} might not have parameters for all subcategories of [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]], then you have to manually add the category to the disambig page. === Alternative names === For those who can't remember how this template's name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. === Technical details === Internally this template uses {{tl|dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. This template uses {{tl|disambig/cat}} to handle the categorisation parameters such as "hospital" and "school". === See also === * {{tl|dablink}} – Basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:Otheruses templates (example usage)]] for the full hatnote index. * {{tl|dn}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article. revision.text: {{documentation subpage}} {{high-risk| 100,000+ }} {{dabnav}} This is the {{tl|disambig}} template. '''Important: Please do not [[WP:SUBST|SUBST:]] this template.''' This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Callsigndis}} – [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Disambig-Chinese-char-title}} – [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tl|Fish-dab}} – [[:Category:Fish common names]] and [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|LatinNameDisambig}} – [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Letter disambig}} – Adds no special category but adds a Latin letter navbox. * {{tl|Letter-NumberCombDisambig}} – [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|MolFormDisambig}} – [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Roaddis}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|WP disambig}} for Wikipedia project and help pages associated with a given shortcut or title For [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]]: * {{tl|SIA}} for any set index article – [[:Category:Set indices]] * {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Set indices on mountains]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|Sportindex}} for sport names – [[:Category:Set indices on sports]] * {{tl|Surname}} for people's surnames – [[:Category:Surnames]] * {{tl|Given name}} for people's given names – [[:Category:Given names]] === Parameters === Sometimes there isn't a specific disambig template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|disambig}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. Up to ten parameters can be fed, and in any order. Like this: :{{tlc|disambig|school|hospital}} Only add a parameter if the disambig page has several items of that type. * {{tlx|disambig|human name}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] (note that you must instead add the category separately if it needs a different [[WP:SORT|sort key]]) * {{tlx|disambig|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] * {{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] * {{tlx|disambig|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tlx|disambig|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|chinese}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tlx|disambig|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|fish}}: for [[:Category:Fish common names]] * {{tlx|disambig|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|latin}}: for [[:Category:Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|letter number}}: for [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tlx|disambig|molform}}: for [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tlx|disambig|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tlx|disambig|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] * {{tlx|disambig|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tlx|disambig|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tlx|disambig|split}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages in need of being split]] For pages that need clean-up use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}, it understands the same parameters. Note that {{tl|disambig}} might not have parameters for all subcategories of [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]], then you have to manually add the category to the disambig page. === Alternative names === For those who can't remember how this template's name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. === Technical details === Internally this template uses {{tl|dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. This template uses {{tl|disambig/cat}} to handle the categorisation parameters such as "hospital" and "school". === See also === * {{tl|dablink}} – Basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:Otheruses templates (example usage)]] for the full hatnote index. * {{tl|dn}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article. {{documentation subpage}} {{high-risk| 100,000+ }} {{dabnav}} This is the {{tl|disambig}} template. '''Important: Please do not [[Wikipedia:Substitution|subst:]] this template.''' This is a general-purpose template, to be placed at the bottom of any article that exists to help readers find other articles with the same or similar names. This concept is called ''[[Wikipedia:Disambiguation|disambiguation]]'' and is used with many common words, such as ''[[Cross (disambiguation)|cross]]'', ''[[Life (disambiguation)|life]]'' and ''[[work]]''. This template automatically adds articles to the [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]]. === Page title fix === In the event that the page title is causing an error, such as [http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%2A%2A%2A&oldid=171348746 what happened] at ''[[***]]'', add the parameter: '''{{para|page-title | page title}}''' . Thus, the [[***]] page would use the syntax: '''{{disambig |page-title = ***}}''' . === Variant templates === For disambiguation pages requiring cleanup, use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}. More specific, alternative templates exist, for disambiguation pages or set index articles whose entries are limited exclusively to items of a particular type. * {{tl|Airport disambig}} for airports – [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tl|Callsigndis}} – [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Disambig-Chinese-char-title}} – [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tl|Geodis}} for place names – [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Hndis}} for people's names – [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] ** {{tl|Hndis-cleanup}} * {{tl|Hospitaldis}} for hospitals or medical centers – [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Letter disambig}} – Adds no special category but adds a Latin letter navbox. * {{tl|Letter-NumberCombDisambig}} – [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|Mathdab}} for mathematics titles – [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tl|MolFormDisambig}} – [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tl|Numberdis}} for numbers – [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tl|Schooldis}} for educational institutions – [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tl|SpeciesLatinNameDisambig}} – [[:Category:Species Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tl|WP disambig}} for Wikipedia project and help pages associated with a given shortcut or title For [[Wikipedia:Disambiguation#Set index articles|set index articles]]: * {{tl|SIA}} for any set index article – [[:Category:Set indices]] * {{tl|Mountainindex}} for mountain names – [[:Category:Set indices on mountains]] * {{tl|Roadindex}} for roads, streets, or highways – [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tl|Shipindex}} for ship names – [[:Category:Set indices on ships]] * {{tl|Sportindex}} for sport names – [[:Category:Set indices on sports]] * {{tl|Surname}} for people's surnames – [[:Category:Surnames]] * {{tl|Given name}} for people's given names – [[:Category:Given names]] === Parameters === Sometimes there isn't a specific disambig template (see list above) that fits for a page, or the page has items in more than one of the above classes. Then use {{tl|disambig}} but with one or more parameters telling which categories to use. Up to ten parameters can be fed, and in any order. Like this: :{{tlc|disambig|school|hospital}} Only add a parameter if the disambig page has several items of that type. * {{tlx|disambig|human name}}: for [[:Category:Human name disambiguation pages]] (note that you must instead add the category separately if it needs a different [[WP:SORT|sort key]]) * {{tlx|disambig|given name}}: [[:Category:Given names]] * {{tlx|disambig|surname}}: for [[:Category:Surnames]] * {{tlx|disambig|airport}}: for [[:Category:Airport disambiguation]] * {{tlx|disambig|callsign}}: for [[:Category:Broadcast call sign disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|chinese}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages with Chinese character titles]] * {{tlx|disambig|church}}: for [[:Category:Church building disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|fish}}: for [[:Category:Fish common names]] * {{tlx|disambig|geo}}: for [[:Category:Place name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|hospital}}: for [[:Category:Hospital disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|latin}}: for [[:Category:Species Latin name disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|letter number}}: for [[:Category:Letter-number combination disambiguation pages]] * {{tlx|disambig|math}}: for [[:Category:Mathematical disambiguation]] * {{tlx|disambig|molform}}: for [[:Category:Molecular formula disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:Molecular formulas]] * {{tlx|disambig|number}}: for [[:Category:Lists of ambiguous numbers]] * {{tlx|disambig|plant}}: for [[:Category:Plant common names]] * {{tlx|disambig|road}}: for [[:Category:Lists of roads sharing the same title]] * {{tlx|disambig|school}}: for [[:Category:Educational institution disambiguation]] * {{tlx|disambig|split}}: for [[:Category:Disambiguation pages in need of being split]] For pages that need clean-up use {{tl|disambig-cleanup}}, it understands the same parameters. Note that {{tl|disambig}} might not have parameters for all subcategories of [[:Category:Disambiguation pages]], then you have to manually add the category to the disambig page. === Alternative names === For those who can't remember how this template's name is abbreviated, the {{tl|disambiguation}}, {{tl|disamb}} and {{tl|dab}} templates all redirect to {{tl|disambig}}. === Technical details === Internally this template uses {{tl|dmbox}}. That template categorises pages into [[:Category:All disambiguation pages]] and [[:Category:All article disambiguation pages]]. This template uses {{tl|disambig/cat}} to handle the categorisation parameters such as "hospital" and "school". === See also === * {{tl|dablink}} – Basic article hatnote, see [[Wikipedia:Otheruses templates (example usage)]] for the full hatnote index. * {{tl|dn}} – Adds an inline "disambiguation needed" tag to an ambiguous link within an article.
